facts.business: NMDC Limited is India's largest iron ore producer and a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Steel, operating highly mechanized iron ore mines in Chhattisgarh and Karnataka, a mechanized diamond mine in Panna, and a newly operationalized Coal Division, while diversifying into steel production and other strategic minerals.

capacity_or_capex.item: NMDC's proportionate share in JV Capex

guidance_or_targets.statement: Double capacity to 100 million tonnes by 2030
Breach 50 million tonne annual production threshold

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matters: Revenue from Operations and Related Royalty & Levies (Revenue `31,553.70 crores); Compliance deviations noted in Secretarial Audit regarding Board composition, Audit Committee, NRC, SRC constitution and meeting gaps.

key_risks: Revenue recognition complexity due to Fe content-based pricing adjustments
Royalty and statutory dues computation accuracy
Corporate governance non-compliances: Board composition (woman director, independent directors), Audit Committee constitution and meeting gaps, NRC and SRC constitution delays
Dependence on iron ore pricing volatility
Operational risks in mining and mineral processing
Regulatory and compliance risks in mining sector
facts.related_party_note: Certain balances under Trade Payables, Advances, Security Deposits, and Other Payables are subject to confirmation and reconciliation. Joint Ventures: NMDC-CMDC Limited (51%), Bastar Railway Pvt. Ltd. (52%), Jharkhand National Mineral Development Corporation Ltd. (60%).
